description: This file contains benchmarking code for mutex implementations, including Abseil's Mutex, std::mutex, and SpinLock. It defines various benchmark functions to measure mutex locking, enqueueing, contention, and condition variable overhead, with specific focus on Abseil synchronization primitives and thread priority management.

classes.name: RaiiLocker<std::mutex>
classes.description: Specialized RAII locker for std::mutex with lock/unlock methods.

classes.name: ScopedThreadMutexPriority
classes.description: RAII class to temporarily set thread mutex priority using Abseil internal thread identity.

methods.name: BM_Mutex
methods.description: Benchmark function measuring the time to acquire and release an Abseil Mutex.

methods.name: DelayNs
methods.description: Function to busy-wait for a specified number of nanoseconds.

methods.name: RaiiLocker
methods.description: Template class providing RAII locking for mutex types.

methods.name: ScopedThreadMutexPriority
methods.description: Sets thread mutex priority temporarily for benchmarking purposes.

methods.name: BM_MutexEnqueue
methods.description: Benchmark simulating mutex enqueueing with thread priorities and contention.

methods.name: BM_Contended
methods.description: Benchmark measuring contention behavior for different mutex types under various critical section durations.

methods.name: SetupBenchmarkArgs
methods.description: Configures benchmark parameters such as thread counts and contention levels.

methods.name: BM_ConditionWaiters
methods.description: Benchmark measuring overhead of condition variable waiters with different class groupings.
